Good to Know

Quick answers

Will marker or gel pen bleed through the pages?

Pages are single-sided with a blank sheet behind each design, which helps, but we can't promise zero bleed-through with heavy alcohol-based markers. Slip a spare sheet of paper behind the page you're coloring and test your pens on a corner first.

Where do I actually buy the books?

We're launching on Amazon in the next couple of weeks. Leave your email above and we'll send you the link the moment it's live — Amazon then handles printing, shipping, tracking and returns.

Who are these coloring books for?

Adults and teens who like relaxed, detailed-but-approachable coloring. Little Animals, Lovely Days uses bolder, simpler lines that also suit confident younger colorists.
